name: upgrade-readiness
description: Readiness audit and go/no-go for major SvelteKit changes: deps, configs, breaking impact, CI/CD, validation. Precedes a migration/refactor execution plan.
use_cases: Svelte 4 to 5 upgrade in a SvelteKit app
CI/CD readiness before a disruptive change
go / no-go on a large refactor or upgrade

verification.description: Resolve dep tree without conflicts (<pm> = the repo's package manager, detected in Phase 1)
No new lint errors from config changes
Adapter output present in expected shape
